items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting is covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9. Priced at the reference level of about 52.
A connection element renewed with the fractured fitting is covered under 7.1.9. Reference level about 27.
Labour on covered pipe work is covered under 7.1.7(f). About 100/h × 3.
Consumables are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e), but this line was declined in every earlier case under this wording, likely as an unproven flat charge.
One attendance per undertaking is covered under 7.1.11. This wording's references put it at about 37-44.
Leak-location equipment is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 (cap 2,500, not reached). The reference price is about 15-20.

items.description: Facade damage from frozen escaped water
items.rationale: Escaped water that saturated the render and then froze is escape-of-water damage under 2.4.3, so it is covered without the optional frost peril. Treated as removal work at the reference level of about 157 per unit.
Taking down damaged finishes on an affected part is covered under 7.1.7(a) via 2.4.3. Reference about 157 per unit.
Re-forming the substrate of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c). Reference about 38.
Unspecified work. It is covered only if it is real work on the affected area (7.1.12, 9.6), so coverage is uncertain and the price is a rough guess.
Substrate preparation is covered under 7.1.7(c). Reference about 31.
The finish system is covered under 7.1.7(d) in the number of coats it requires. Reference about 59.
Drying needed before the repair can proceed is covered under 7.1.7(c). Reference about 250.
Priming the affected area is covered under 7.1.7. Reference about 117.
Labour on covered work is covered under 7.1.7(f). About 55/h × 5.
An unspecified flat rate is most likely an administrative or processing charge, excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12.
